title: CSRF Protection Validation
summary: CSRF protection is now active with same-site cookies, CSRF tokens, and origin validation for all state-changing requests.

layer1_sameSiteCookies.description: All session and auth cookies use SameSite=Strict to prevent cross-origin cookie sending

bearerTokenBypass.description: Requests using Bearer token authentication bypass CSRF checks because Bearer tokens are not auto-sent by browsers (unlike cookies)
bearerTokenBypass.rationale: CSRF attacks exploit automatic cookie sending; Bearer tokens require explicit JavaScript to include, making CSRF impossible for API-only clients

tokenEndpoint.description: Returns a CSRF token and sets _session and _csrf cookies
tokenEndpoint.usage: Frontend fetches this endpoint on page load, includes the token in x-csrf-token header for state-changing requests

productionRecommendations: Verify FRONTEND_URL and BACKEND_URL environment variables are set for production origin validation
Enable secure cookies in production (set NODE_ENV=production)
Consider double-submit cookie pattern for stateless CSRF protection
Add CSRF token rotation on each state-changing request for enhanced security
